headline: Kshitij Polyline appoints Shashi Kala Dhabriya as independent director
summary: Kshitij Polyline Limited announced the appointment of Mrs. Shashi Kala Dhabriya as a Non-Executive Independent Director, effective October 7, 2026. The filing was submitted to the stock exchange as part of routine corporate governance updates. Such board appointments are procedural disclosures for listed entities and carry no direct financial impact for retail shareholders.
why_it_matters: Routine board filing with no financial impact for retail investors

headline: Rajesh Nandkishore Pherwani steps down as independent director of Kshitij Polyline
hook: Board seat vacant at Kshitij Polyline
summary: Kshitij Polyline Limited announced that Mr. Rajesh Nandkishore Pherwani has resigned from his position as a Non-Executive Independent Director, effective October 7, 2026. This departure alters the composition of the company's board of directors. Such board changes are routine corporate governance updates for listed micro-cap entities. Indian retail investors holding the stock should note leadership shuffles when evaluating board independence.
why_it_matters: Board composition shifts at micro-cap companies
